newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC sees 320 bln yen group capital investment.
newsitem.headline: NEC sees 320 bln yen group capital investment.

text.p: NEC Corp said on Thursday that it plans group capital investment of 320 billion yen in fiscal 1997/98, which began on April 1.
The company also said it expected group operating profit of 240 billion yen in 1997/98, which ends next March 31.
Japan's biggest chip maker said earlier that it planned 190 billion yen in capital investment in semiconductor operations in 1997/98, unchanged from its actual investment in 1996/97.
The company also said it expected its semiconductor output in fiscal 1997/98 to rise 18 percent year-on-year to 1.3 trillion yen.
Its actual semiconductor output fell six percent to 1.1 trillion yen in 1996/97, NEC said.
